notes: Standalone example: whether the native messaging host the built-in sensor relies on is registered for Chrome, Chromium and Edge. It measures nothing: the measurements come from the browser extension, which only the built-in path can receive.

commands.linux:
# Standalone example: is the SaaS monitoring native messaging host registered, per browser.
for d in /etc/opt/chrome/native-messaging-hosts /etc/chromium/native-messaging-hosts /etc/opt/edge/native-messaging-hosts; do
  if [ -f "$d/dev.mustra.saas_monitor.json" ]; then echo "registered: $d"; else echo "not registered: $d"; fi
done
commands.darwin:
# Standalone example: is the SaaS monitoring native messaging host registered, per browser.
for d in "/Library/Google/Chrome/NativeMessagingHosts" "/Library/Microsoft/Edge/NativeMessagingHosts" "/Library/Application Support/Chromium/NativeMessagingHosts"; do
  if [ -f "$d/dev.mustra.saas_monitor.json" ]; then echo "registered: $d"; else echo "not registered: $d"; fi
done
